parsed.explanation: Documented exposure is societal: an official 2018 assessment found attitudes hostile toward publicly visible LGBTI people, explicitly including gender identity and expression, particularly in the capital — tier-3 harm with essentially no recourse (no anti-discrimination law, no hate-crime enhancement, a judiciary not functioning as a protection avenue), so a targeted visitor has no realistic remedy. There is no trans-specific offence, no documented police sweeps or extortion, no facility or custody rule, and no documented border/document friction. The 2017 advocacy and marriage bills are resident-facing, their post-November-2017 status unverified; the 2019 activist death is a single unresolved, dated incident carrying little rate-value; the 2010 camp harassment is dated and disaster-specific. Custody, border screening and facilities are simply undocumented — unresolved rather than safe, and not a known exposure. Elevated Risk.
